goal.insight: Show the flow of food waste across the four supply chain stages (production, processing, retail, consumption) as a composition, making the relative magnitude of waste at each stage visually prominent
Visually juxtapose each stage's waste share with its corresponding carbon emission contribution, highlighting stages where carbon intensity is disproportionate to waste volume
Overlay or annotate the proportion of avoidable waste within each stage to make high-intervention-potential stages visually distinct
Compare waste distribution patterns across regions (e.g., high-income vs low-income countries) to emphasize how supply chain hotspots shift geographically
Emphasize the stages and regions where high avoidable waste and high carbon emissions converge, visually signaling priority intervention points
